Part 2

"Fine," Daren sighed. "But if we're doing this, I'm dragging JT into it. No chance I'm captaining this circus alone." Connor raised his glass. "That's why you're co-captains. Every bad decision deserves a witness." Chris nodded solemnly. "The four horsemen of poor financial planning shall ride again." Somewhere in the bar, a pool cue snapped, which everyone agreed felt like a good omen. The Mean Machine officially had leadership, even if it looked more like a support group than a command structure.
